						🚀 UPSC CDS 2 2025 Revision Final Result with Marks: Out at upsc.gov.in!

						The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the official notification for the Combined Defence Services (CDS) II Examination 2025. Online applications will start on May 28, 2025, and the last date to apply is June 20, 2025. Candidates can apply at https://upsc.gov.in for roles in the Indian Military Academy (IMA), Indian Naval Academy (INA), Air Force Academy (AFA), and Officers’ Training Academy (OTA). The application fee is Rs. 200/- for General/OBC candidates, while SC/ST and female candidates are exempt. Candidates must be aged 20–24 years, with age relaxation as per the official notification. Selection will be based on a Written Examination and SSB Interview (Stage-I, II). Start your journey to serve in India’s defence forces! #UPSC2025 #CDS2
